messages.content:
Subject: Comparing plans

What's the actual difference between Pro and Business for a 10-person design agency? The pricing page lists a lot of features but I can't tell which ones would matter to us. We mainly need client approvals and time tracking.

Subject: Annual renewal at wrong price

Dear billing team,

Our annual subscription renewed on the 3rd at $5,880 for 35 seats. Last year we negotiated a price of $12 per seat per month with your sales representative, David Chen, as part of a two-year agreement. That should come to $5,040 for the year. The renewal was charged at the standard list price of $14 per seat instead.

I've attached the... well, I can't attach it here, but I have an email from David dated 14 October last year confirming the two-year pricing. I'm happy to forward it.

Please correct the renewal charge and refund the difference of $840. Please also make sure next year's renewal is set up at the agreed price, so we don't have to raise this again.

Account: acct_mv3519
Invoice: INV-64330

Regards,
Francesca Moretti
Finance Manager, Moretti Viaggi S.r.l.

Subject: Import + seat question

We're importing from Trello, and the importer wants to invite all 45 Trello board members to our workspace. We only want to import the cards, not invite everyone. Can we skip the invites? And would uninvited people cost us seats?

Subject: Gantt view

Where is the Gantt / timeline view? My manager showed me one in her account but I only see Board, List and Calendar.

Subject: Payment method for a client

I manage the workspace for a client (I'm a consultant). They want to put their own company card on the account instead of me paying and reinvoicing. How can they add their card without getting full admin access?

Subject: Security questionnaire + DPA

Our procurement team needs a signed DPA and your latest SOC 2 Type II report before we can renew. We also have a 120-question vendor security questionnaire - who should I send it to? Renewal date is end of month.

Subject: Accidental second subscription

I accidentally signed up twice with two different emails (kasia.nowak@gmail.com and kasia@nowakdesign.pl), so I'm paying for two subscriptions. I only need one. Can you refund the most recent one and close that account?

Subject: Customer since 2018

Hi all,

I've been a customer since 2018, when you were a much smaller company, and I wanted to share some honest reflections. In the early years, every piece of feedback I sent got a thoughtful personal reply, often from someone on the product team. Features I asked for sometimes appeared a few months later, and it felt like a partnership.

These days the product is more powerful, but it also feels more generic, and my feedback seems to disappear into a void. Three of the last four changes to the task view made my workflow slower, not faster, and I couldn't find anywhere to explain why.

I'm not writing to complain for the sake of it. I still think this is the best tool in its category, and I still pay for it happily. I'd just like to know whether there's a customer advisory group or a beta programme where long-time users can give feedback before changes ship. I'd gladly take part.

Best regards,
Anders Holm

Subject: Request: better permissions for custom fields

Some of our custom fields (like "Budget") should only be editable by managers. Could you add per-field permissions? Right now anyone with edit access can change the budget.

Subject: Payment failed + invoice for records

Our payment failed on the 1st because of a bank change. We've updated the account details. Can you retry the payment? Once it goes through, please send a paid invoice for our records. Org ID 29012.
feature request: let us set a default assignee per project
Is the API down? All requests timing out from our servers since 14:30 UTC. The web app is also very slow for us, but it loads.

Subject: Moving tasks between projects

How do I move a task from one project to another without losing its comments and attachments? When I tried copy-paste I lost the history.

Subject: Refund - didn't use the product

Our team signed up for 3 months in the hope we'd switch over from spreadsheets but it just never happened. Nobody used it after the first week. We've cancelled now. Would you consider refunding the last two months? Account acct_z4n8mm.

Subject: Delete workspace but keep my user

I own a workspace I created for a side project. I want to delete that workspace but keep my user account, because I'm also a member of my employer's workspace. Will deleting the workspace affect my membership elsewhere?
Where do I download all past invoices at once? I can only see them one by one.

Subject: Deletion confirmation for GDPR

Three weeks ago I asked for all my personal data to be deleted under GDPR (ticket #58812) and got an automated reply, but no confirmation since. The legal deadline is one month. Please confirm the deletion is complete, in writing.

Subject: Slow + disconnects

The web app has become slow and every 15 minutes or so it shows "Connection lost, reconnecting..." for a few seconds. Our internet is stable (tested). It's happening to everyone in our office. Not blocking us but very disruptive.

Subject: Verification email for new account

I just signed up and it says to verify my email before I can log in. The verification email never came. Checked spam, promotions, everything. Signed up as kwame.asante@outlook.com about 30 min ago.
Moved 30 tasks between sections and half of them went back to their original section after I refreshed. Tried again, same thing.

Subject: Support was excellent

I wanted to thank Rosa from your support team. She stayed on chat with me for over an hour to sort out our migration issue and followed up the next day. That's rare these days.
Could the calendar view show tasks as multi-day bars (start to due date), instead of only on the due date?

Subject: Add seats before Monday

We're onboarding 10 new sales reps on Monday morning and need 10 more seats on our Business plan before then. Also, I noticed our plan says Business (legacy). Is that different from the current Business plan, and should we switch while we're adding seats?

Subject: Outlook calendar sync one-way only

Tasks with due dates show up in my Outlook calendar, but when I move them in Outlook, the due date here doesn't change. I thought the sync was two-way? It says two-way in the integration settings.

Subject: Rate limited + webhook question

Hi, we're hitting 429s way more than expected: about 30 requests per minute and we get limited. Docs say the limit is 100/min. Also, unrelated, can a single webhook subscription cover multiple projects or do we need one per project? Example 429 request: req_a9d0e711.

We were charged $480 this month instead of $400. Please correct that, and please send a corrected invoice with the right amount, since our accounting team already booked the wrong one. Invoice INV-63881.
Exported CSV files are vulnerable to CSV injection: a task title starting with =HYPERLINK(...) becomes a live formula when opened in Excel. Suggest escaping leading =, +, -, @.
The help centre articles are out of date. Half the screenshots show the old interface. Makes it hard to follow.

Subject: GDPR data request

Under Article 15 of the GDPR, I request a copy of all personal data you hold about me, including account data, usage logs and any data shared with third parties. My account email is kasper.nielsen@post.dk. Please respond within the statutory one month.
how do i export everything? like all projects, all tasks, comments, attachments. need a full backup
Custom fields of type "currency" show $ even though I set the currency to EUR in the field settings. Values are correct, just the symbol is wrong.

Subject: Strange API keys on our account

While auditing our settings today I found two API keys I don't recognize, created last Thursday at 3am. None of our admins created them. I've revoked them for now. Can you tell us which IP they were created from? Org ID 90312.
Hi! Loving the trial. Could we extend it by a week? We'd also like to know if there's a discount for signing up before the trial ends.

Subject: Automatic reply

Thank you for contacting Brightwell Support. We have received your message and will reply within 2 business days. Your ticket number is #BW-229017.

This is an automated message, please do not reply.

Subject: Annual statement

For our audit we need a statement of all payments made to you in the last financial year (April to March). Is there a way to download a statement rather than individual invoices? Org ID 38821.

Hi, I'm not a professional security person, just a developer who uses your app, but I think I stumbled on something you should know about. I was looking at the network requests in my browser's dev tools (I was trying to debug our own integration) and I noticed that when I load a project, the response includes the email addresses and phone numbers of every member of the workspace, including people who aren't in that project and guests from other companies. None of that information is shown in the UI, so I don't think it's supposed to be sent to the browser at all. It means any guest can see the contact details of everyone in the workspace just by opening dev tools. I haven't done anything with the data. I just wanted to report it. Is there someone specific I should send details to?
Can I get a notification when a task in a project I follow is completed? Right now I only get notified for my own tasks.

Subject: Mobile + feature idea

The iOS app crashes whenever I rotate my phone while a task is open. Minor. And an idea: could the app support Siri Shortcuts so I can say "add task" hands-free?

Is the whole thing down or is it just us? Nothing has loaded since about 20 minutes ago. At first it was slow, then the boards started showing "Failed to load", and now I just get a blank white page with your logo in the corner. Everyone in our office (about 25 people) has the same thing, on Wi-Fi, on phones, on laptops. We tried from someone's home internet too, same thing. Our whole day revolves around this app. Our dispatch team can't see which jobs are assigned, so we have engineers sitting in vans not knowing where to go. Please let us know what's happening and roughly how long. Workspace: fieldforce-hvac.ourapp.com

Subject: Suspected account compromise - unusual task activity

Hi,

I'm the admin of our company workspace. This morning several team members reported that tasks had been reassigned to a user none of us recognised, and that comments had been added to client projects asking clients to "update their payment details" via an external link. The comments were posted from the account of our sales director, who has been on annual leave with no laptop for the past week.

We've suspended his account and deleted the comments, but at least three clients may have already clicked the link. We need to know how the attacker got into his account, whether they accessed any other accounts, and a list of everything the compromised account did in the last seven days.

Workspace: larkspur-consulting.ourapp.com
Compromised account: m.adeyemi@larkspurconsulting.com

Thanks,
Joanna Reid
Operations Manager

Subject: Can't pay invoice link

The payment link in the invoice email (INV-63411) gives "This link has expired". The invoice is due tomorrow. Can you send a new link? We pay by card, not bank transfer.

Subject: On-premise option?

Do you offer an on-premise or private cloud deployment? We're a defence contractor and our data can't leave our own infrastructure. If not, do you have a government cloud offering?

Subject: Trial expired, need 3 days

Our trial expired yesterday. Our CFO approved the purchase this morning but the payment won't go through until our procurement system processes it, which takes 3 business days. Can you reactivate our workspace in the meantime? We have a client presentation on Wednesday that uses boards we built during the trial. Workspace: bluestone-advisory.ourapp.com

Subject: SAML certificate expiring

Our Azure AD signing certificate expires in 10 days. What's the safest way to update it on your side without locking everyone out? Can we add the new certificate before the old one expires?

Subject: Deleting workspace - need export first

We want our workspace deleted once we've taken a full export. The export button gives us tasks but not attachments. How do we get the attachments too, and then who deletes the workspace? It's oldmill-arts.ourapp.com.

I cancelled last month (got an email saying it was cancelled) but today I see my plan is still showing as active with a renewal date next week. Is it cancelled or not? I don't want to be charged again.

Subject: Charged old price after downgrade

We downgraded from Business to Starter last month and I got the confirmation email. But the charge this month was the Business price, $180 instead of $60. Our workspace is copperline.ourapp.com. Please correct this.

Subject: Reassign project ownership

The owner of several of our key projects is leaving. How do I change the owner of a project to someone else? The "owner" field is greyed out even though I'm a workspace admin.
The checkout page keeps saying "Your card was declined" but my bank app shows no attempt at all. So it's not reaching my bank. Tried two cards.

Subject: Invoices going to wrong person

Invoices are being emailed to a former employee (s.kerr@lomondtech.co.uk). Please change the billing contact to finance@lomondtech.co.uk and resend the last 3 invoices there.

My husband set up this subscription on our shared card. He passed away in the spring and I'm going through all our subscriptions. I don't know his login. Can you please cancel it? The card ends in 8812 and the charges say OURAPP*SUBSCR. I'm not sure what else you need.

Subject: Personal access token for a bot

We want a bot account to make API calls, but personal access tokens are tied to a person and we don't want it to break when that person leaves. Is there a service account or workspace-level token option?

Subject: Two notification problems

Our Microsoft Teams integration stopped posting task updates to our channel yesterday. Also, the notification emails that do come through are arriving hours late. Are these related? We use both heavily.
The Android app crashes whenever I open notifications. Also, I've stopped getting email notifications entirely since last week. So right now I basically don't know when anything happens. Help!

Subject: Account takeover - need urgent help

Hello,

I'm the owner of a small accounting firm's workspace. This morning I found that I've been removed as the owner, and a different account is now listed as owner and admin. I can still log in, but only as a regular member. The new owner account uses an email address I don't recognise (finance.team.acc@proton.me).

Our workspace holds sensitive client financial documents for about 80 clients. I need you to restore me as the owner, lock out the unknown account, and tell me what it accessed. This is extremely urgent.

My email: s.whitmore@whitmore-accounts.co.uk
Workspace: whitmore-accounts.ourapp.com

Sarah Whitmore

Subject: Language setting reverting

I set my language to Spanish in settings, it saves, but next time I log in it's back to English. Happened 4 times now. Account: acct_77e2hs

Subject: Abroad and can't get texts

I'm travelling in Japan for two weeks and my UK number doesn't receive the 2FA SMS here. I urgently need to access a client file today. Is there any other way to verify it's me? My login is h.walsh@walshconsulting.co.uk

Subject: Typing lag in comments

When writing a comment on a task with many attachments, there's a noticeable delay between typing and the letters appearing. Tasks without attachments are fine. Chrome on Windows 11.
We want to buy but our legal team wants to change some terms in your subscription agreement (liability cap and governing law). Is that negotiable at 50 seats, or only for Enterprise?

The entire app has been read-only for our company for the last hour. We can view everything but any edit fails with "Workspace is in maintenance mode". There was no maintenance announcement. We're 60 people trying to close out our month-end.
our trial says 2 days left but we only signed up yesterday?? is that a mistake

Subject: Zendesk integration + seat question

The Zendesk integration stopped creating tasks from new tickets yesterday. Could you check it? Also, does the Zendesk integration need a separate seat for the integration user, or is it free?

Subject: Mobile app shows old data

The Android app shows the board as it was yesterday morning. Pull-to-refresh spins but nothing changes. On the web everything is current. I've tried clearing the cache and logging out. It's a problem because our drivers use the app to see their route assignments, and yesterday two of them went to the wrong addresses because they were looking at stale data. We have 14 drivers on Android. Account: acct_dr1v3r
When I filter by a custom field and then sort by due date, the filter is removed. Doing it in the other order works. Low priority, just reporting it.

Subject: Refund and delete

Hi, I bought the annual plan 5 days ago but it doesn't suit my workflow after all. Could I get a refund? And after that, please delete my account and data entirely. Thanks for understanding.
Receiving the same notification email 4-5 times for one comment. Started this morning. It's flooding my inbox.
Login keeps timing out at the 2FA step, then I have to start again. Can't get in reliably. Once that's fixed, a request: could you add "Sign in with Apple"? My whole family uses Apple devices.

Subject: Leaked credentials on a public repo

While scanning GitHub I found what looks like one of your internal API keys in a public repository belonging to someone who appears to be your employee (the repo is named ourapp-internal-scripts). I haven't used the key. Let me know where to send the link so you can revoke it.

Subject: Switch workspace to another plan owner

Our subscription is on my personal card because I set it up years ago. The company wants to take over billing on a new company account and upgrade to Enterprise at the same time. What's the cleanest way to do both without interrupting service?
password manager filled in my old password and now the account's locked. i know the right password now, can someone unlock it? acct_4c81nd

The timeline view is really slow with our 600 tasks, takes about 30 seconds to load. Could you add an option to load only the next 3 months? That would fix it for us and probably help performance in general.
Everything times out. Can't load anything. Whole team. Please help.

The CSV export is driving me mad. I need to send our monthly project status to our board, and I export the project to CSV and open it in Excel. First, the columns are in a different order every time I export. Second, the custom field columns have internal IDs as headers (like cf_8812) instead of the field names. Third, any description with a comma in it breaks the columns, so rows get split in the wrong place. I've been fixing it by hand for three months, and it takes me an hour each time. Is there an export option that gives consistent columns with proper headers, or am I doing something wrong? Workspace: coralbay-housing.ourapp.com

Subject: Azure AD SAML setup

We're configuring SAML SSO with Azure AD (Entra ID). We've added your app from the gallery and set the identifier and reply URL from your docs, but users get "AADSTS50011: The redirect URI specified in the request does not match". Which reply URL should we be using? Org ID: 30418

Subject: Migrating from Monday.com

Hi team,

We're moving our 60-person agency from Monday.com and would like to bring over about 120 boards with their items, subitems, statuses, owners, due dates, and ideally the comment history (they call them updates). We've looked at your import options and see CSV and a direct Trello and Asana importer, but nothing for Monday.

What would you recommend? If CSV is the only route, is there a template that maps well to Monday's export format? We're especially worried about subitems becoming separate tasks and losing the parent link, and about people assignments not matching because our emails are slightly different between the two tools.

We'd like to switch over during a quiet week at the end of the month, so we have about three weeks to plan. If you offer migration help as a paid service, we'd be open to that too.

Thanks,
Laura Castellano
Operations Director, Brightline Creative

Subject: API: filter by custom field

How do I filter tasks by a custom field value using the list endpoint? I tried ?custom_field[cf_220]=Urgent and it returns all tasks. Is the syntax different?

Subject: IdP-initiated login fails

SP-initiated SSO works but when users click the app tile in OneLogin they get "SSO_ERR_22: InResponseTo not expected". Does your app support IdP-initiated flows? Our workspace is meridian-health.ourapp.com

Subject: Feature request + small bug

Hi! Feature request: could you add a "snooze" option for tasks, so they disappear from my list until a chosen date? And a small bug I noticed: the "Today" filter includes tasks due tomorrow if you're east of UTC. Thanks for a great product!
Task I moved to another project shows up in BOTH projects now. Editing one edits the other. Is it duplicated or linked?
Can you tell me what time the pharmacy on Oak Street closes today?

Our old team workspace from 2019 is still around. Nobody has used it in years, and the owner left long ago. We'd like it deleted. It's called "Growth Squad" and is linked to our domain @kestrelmarketing.com. I'm an admin in our current workspace, not that one.

Subject: Mobile app feedback

General feedback on the mobile app: it's fine for checking tasks, but creating anything is a pain. Too many taps to add a due date and an assignee. Compared to the web app, it feels like an afterthought. No specific bug, just the overall experience.

Subject: Sub-processors in the US

Which of your sub-processors are in the United States, and do you rely on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework or on SCCs for those transfers? Our DPO needs this for our transfer impact assessment.

Subject: Typo in my email at signup

I made a typo in my email when I signed up: it's registered as alexandra.kowalczykk@gmail.com (double k) but should be alexandra.kowalczyk@gmail.com. I can still log in because I know the password. Can it be corrected? Also my first name is misspelled in my profile and I can't edit it.

Subject: Slow API + webhooks delayed

Our webhook deliveries are arriving 10-20 minutes late, and API calls are taking several seconds each. We use webhooks to trigger our warehouse picking, so delays mean orders ship late. Is there a known performance issue? Delivery ID example: evt_01JB2W8K9F.
changes not saving. i edit a task description, click away, come back and it's the old version
exported our workspace but the zip file is only 2MB and we have gigabytes of attachments. are attachments not included??

Subject: Testing the support form

Just testing whether this form works before I send a real question. Please ignore.

Is there a way to hide my email address from other members of the workspace? I'd like them to see my name only. Privacy thing.

Hi! When I undo (Ctrl+Z) after deleting a task, it restores the task but without its subtasks. The subtasks are just gone. I found them in trash but had to restore them one by one and re-link them. Is that expected?

Subject: Financial hardship

I lost my job last month and I'm cutting all subscriptions. I've already cancelled, but I was charged $79 two days before I did it. Is there any way I could get that back? It would genuinely help. Thank you for considering it.

Subject: Email notifications + invoice

Our finance lead isn't getting any email notifications, including the invoice emails. Can you check whether her address is being suppressed on your side (maybe it bounced once)? Her email is k.osei@lumora-finance.com. And please resend last month's invoice to her.

Hello, we are a school with 35 teachers using the free plan. The headteacher approved budget for the Education plan. How do we upgrade and does the education discount apply automatically, or do we need to send proof? Thank you, Mr. Adebayo

Subject: Custom fields per project

How do I add a custom field only to one project, not the whole workspace? When I add one, it appears in every project.

Subject: iOS app drains battery and gets hot

Hello,

Several people in our field team have reported that since the latest iOS app update (version 6.1), their iPhones get noticeably hot and the battery drains much faster when the app is open. One colleague said her battery went from 100% to 30% in three hours of normal use, mostly checking tasks and adding photos to site reports. Before the update, the app barely registered in the battery usage stats.

In iOS settings, your app now accounts for 45-60% of battery usage for the people affected. Some have started closing it between uses, which means they miss push notifications for new assignments.

Affected devices so far: iPhone 13, iPhone 14 Pro and iPhone 15, all on iOS 18. Background App Refresh is on for all of them. Is this a known issue with 6.1?

Workspace ID: ws_52018

Thanks,
Nathan Brooks
Field Operations Coordinator
Can I get a demo? Looking for something to manage marketing campaigns for a 12-person team.

Subject: Refund request - feature removed

You removed the time-tracking feature from the Pro plan last month and moved it to Business. We paid annually for Pro specifically because it included time tracking. Either restore it for us until our renewal, or refund the remaining months. Account acct_1m0tpq
The custom field values on about half our tasks were wiped overnight. All the "Budget" and "Client" fields are empty. Other fields fine. This is our whole reporting setup. Org ID 64410.
Trial expired this morning and now I can't even export the tasks I created. I'm not ready to pay yet but I need that data. Can you reopen the trial for a day so I can get it out?
When I try to invite a freelancer with a gmail address it says "This workspace only allows members from approved domains". I'm an admin. Where do I add an exception for a single person?
CSRF on the /settings/email endpoint, no token required. I can change a logged-in user's email via a malicious page. Reporting privately, please advise.

Login fails with error AUTH-2290 "credential mismatch". Tried resetting password, same error with the new one. Workspace: kestrel-analytics.ourapp.com
We cancelled because we thought we were moving to another tool, but the migration fell through. Can we un-cancel? Our plan hasn't ended yet, it ends on the 20th. Workspace: grey-heron.ourapp.com

How do I archive a whole project without deleting it? Also, I tried archiving individual tasks and the archive button does nothing, no error, just nothing. Chrome on Windows.

Subject: Slow uploads

Uploading attachments is extremely slow: 20MB takes several minutes. Downloads are fast. Our connection is 1Gbps. Is there a throttle on uploads?

I'm on the free plan. Always have been. So why did you charge me $8 this morning? I didn't upgrade anything. Please refund and tell me what happened.

I use the "email me a login code" option instead of a password. For the last two days the code never arrives. Checked spam. Other emails from you (like comment notifications) do arrive. My address is ruth.adler@zohomail.eu.

Subject: Scheduled report emails missing

We have 4 scheduled reports that email PDFs to our managers every Friday. Last Friday none of them arrived. The reports still show as "scheduled" in settings. Can you resend them and check why they failed? Our weekly leadership review depends on them.

Subject: Security vulnerability in public share links

Hello,

I'm a penetration tester, and during an authorised test for one of your customers (they've given me written permission to contact you), I found an issue with the public share link feature.

When a board is shared publicly, the link contains a token. If the owner later disables public sharing, the old link stops working in the browser, but the API endpoint behind it still returns the full board data, including tasks, comments and attachment URLs, when called directly with the old token. The token doesn't seem to be revoked server-side; only the front end checks whether sharing is enabled.

This means anyone who ever had a public link can keep reading the board indefinitely, even after the owner thinks it's private again. The customer considers this high severity.

I'd like to share the full technical details with your security team. Please let me know the best contact.

Regards,
Isabelle Martin
Senior Consultant, Clearwater Security

Subject: Close account - moving abroad

I'm moving to another country and won't be freelancing for a while. Please delete my account. Before that, can you tell me how to download my invoices? I might need them for my taxes.

Subject: Unauthorised access by former contractor

Hello,

We've discovered that a former contractor, whose engagement ended six weeks ago, has been accessing our workspace. We removed him as a member when his contract ended, but it turns out he'd created a personal access token for the API while he was working with us. Our logs show that token being used almost daily since he left, most recently yesterday, to read tasks and download attachments from our R&D projects.

We've now revoked the token, but we need your help with several things urgently: a full list of API calls made with that token after his removal date; confirmation of exactly which files were downloaded; and whether there are any other tokens or sessions still associated with his account.

We'll likely be taking legal action, so please preserve all relevant logs.

Org ID: 55840
Former contractor's email: d.harlan@freelance-dev.net

Regards,
Victoria Lang
Chief Information Security Officer

Subject: App uses a lot of battery

The iOS app is using about 30% of my battery according to the battery settings, even though I only open it a few times a day. It seems to be running in the background constantly. Is there a setting to stop background refresh just for your app?

Subject: Multi-year contract

We'd like to lock in current pricing for 3 years for our 300 seats, since your prices have gone up twice in two years. Is a multi-year agreement with price protection possible? Our renewal is in about 8 weeks.

My phone was stolen yesterday, along with my backup codes, which were saved in the notes app. I can't get past the 2FA screen. How do I prove it's me and reset 2FA? I can answer security questions or send ID. Email: kenji.watanabe@outlook.jp
The desktop app uses 3GB of RAM after a few hours and my whole laptop slows down. I have to restart it twice a day. Is this a known memory leak?

Subject: Lost work after crash

My browser crashed while I was writing a long task description, and when I reopened it, the whole description was gone, even though I'd been typing for 20 minutes and it showed "Saved" several times. Is there a version history I can restore from?
Refund request: I was charged for my renewal the day after I cancelled. Cancellation email attached... well, I can't attach, but I have it. Email: w.chen@pacificrim.co

Subject: Complete outage - all regions

URGENT

Our entire organisation has been unable to use your platform since 07:45 UTC. That's our offices in London, Frankfurt and Singapore, over 600 users. The web app returns a 502 Bad Gateway error, the mobile apps show "Unable to connect", and the API returns 503 for every request, which has also stopped our automated order-processing pipeline.
